item.title: Grain dispute splits Ukraine and Israel even as they fight allied enemies
item.description: Tense relations soured further after Ukraine accused Israel of buying grain harvested by Russia in occupied territory. Meanwhile, Russia and Iran have grown closer.

item.title: Marco Rubio says offensive stage of Iran war is over
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio told a White House press briefing on Tuesday that the United States had completed Epic Fury, its offensive operation against Iran, adding that “We’re done with that stage of it”, echoing remarks to Congress almost a month into a fragile truce. Read our blog to see how the day's events unfolded.

item.title: German Leaders Clash With Spy Chiefs Over Domestic Threat From Iran
item.description: Intelligence agents have privately warned of the potential of hybrid attacks from Iran-linked groups. But political leaders, including Chancellor Friedrich Merz, have publicly played down the risk.

item.title: A Project in Europe Tested Whether Students Could Live Without Smartphones
item.description: For three weeks, thousands of children in Europe went without social media or their smartphones, or both. This is the diary of their digital detox.
